description: This file defines a functional interface named RequestHandler, which specifies a single method handleRequest for handling WebDAV HTTP requests within the Ofbiz framework. It includes imports for servlet classes and contains documentation for the method parameters and exceptions.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A functional interface for handling WebDAV requests, defining a single method handleRequest that processes HTTP requests and responses within a servlet context.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles a WebDAV request by processing the HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, and ServletContext. Can throw ServletException or IOException.
